7762-wanderers.title: Wanderers
7762-wanderers.creator: Knut Hamsun
7762-wanderers.description: A book by Knut Hamsun. "Hunger" opened the first period and "Pan" marked its climax, but it came to an end only with the eight-act drama of "Vendt the Monk" in 1902, and traces of it are to be found in everything that Hamsun ever wrote.

arxiv-2203-16945.title: Semantic Pose Verification for Outdoor Visual Localization with Self-supervised Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2203-16945.creator: Semih Orhan, Jose J. Guerrero, Yalin Bastanlar
arxiv-2203-16945.description: Abstract Any city-scale visual localization system has to overcome long-term appearance changes, such as varying illumination conditions or seasonal changes between query and database images. Since semantic content is more robust to such changes, we exploit semantic information to improve visual localization. In our scenario, the database consists of gnomonic views generated from panoramic images (e.g.

arxiv-2302-08973.title: Measuring Equality in Machine Learning Security Defenses: A Case Study in Speech Recognition DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Conference: To Appear in the Proceedings of the 16th ACM W
arxiv-2302-08973.creator: Luke E. Richards, Edward Raff, Cynthia Matuszek
arxiv-2302-08973.description: Abstract . Over the past decade, the machine learning security community has developed a myriad of defenses for evasion attacks. An understudied question in that community is: for whom do these defenses defend? This work considers common approaches to defending learned systems and how security defenses result in performance inequities across different sub-populations.

arxiv-2305-15334.title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
arxiv-2305-15334.creator: Shishir G. Patil, Tianjun Zhang, Xin Wang, Joseph E. Gonzalez
arxiv-2305-15334.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have seen an impressive wave of advances recently, with models now excelling in a variety of tasks, such as mathematical reasoning and program synthesis. However, their potential to effectively use tools via API calls remains unfulfilled.

arxiv-2403-13359.title: 6 6 -torsion and integral points on quartic surfaces
arxiv-2403-13359.creator: S. Chan, P. Koymans, C. Pagano, E. Sofos
arxiv-2403-13359.description: Abstract . We prove matching upper and lower bounds for the average of the 6 6 -torsion of class groups of quadratic fields. Furthermore, we count the number of integer solutions on an affine quartic surface. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11N37 (primary), 11R29, 11D45 (secondary). 1.

arxiv-2407-17504.title: Gravitating Skyrmions with localized fermions
arxiv-2407-17504.creator: Vladimir Dzhunushaliev, Vladimir Folomeev, Jutta Kunz, Yakov Shnir
arxiv-2407-17504.description: Abstract We consider self-gravitating Skyrmions in the presence of Dirac fermions, that carry spin and isospin. By varying the gravitational and the Yukawa coupling constants, we investigate the spectral flow of the fermion eigenvalue associated with a zero mode in the absence of gravity. We demonstrate that the backreaction of the fermion can strongly influence the Skyrmion-fermion configurations.

arxiv-2501-10173.title: Optimal Restart Strategies for Parameter-dependent Optimization Algorithms
arxiv-2501-10173.creator: Lisa Schönenberger and Hans-Georg Beyer
arxiv-2501-10173.description: Abstract This paper examines restart strategies for algorithms whose successful termination depends on an unknown parameter λ \lambda . After each restart, λ \lambda is increased, until the algorithm terminates successfully. It is assumed that there is a unique, unknown, optimal value for λ \lambda . For the algorithm to run successfully, this value must be reached or surpassed.

arxiv-2503-03500.title: Topo Goes Political: TDA-Based Controversy Detection in Imbalanced Reddit Political Data
arxiv-2503-03500.creator: Arvindh Arun, Karuna K Chandra, Akshit Sinha, Balakumar Velayutham, Jashn Arora, Manish Jain, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru
arxiv-2503-03500.description: Abstract . The detection of controversial content in political discussions on the Internet is a critical challenge in maintaining healthy digital discourse. Unlike much of the existing literature that relies on synthetically balanced data, our work preserves the natural distribution of controversial and non-controversial posts. This real-world imbalance highlights a core challenge that needs to be addressed for practical deployment.

arxiv-2504-15746.title: Enhancing Tennis Training with Real-Time Swing Data Visualisation in Immersive Virtual Reality
arxiv-2504-15746.description: Abstract Recent advances in immersive technology have opened up new ways in sports training, particularly for activities requiring precise motor skills such as tennis. In this paper, we demonstrate a virtual reality (VR) tennis training system that integrates real-time performance feedback via a wearable sensor device.

arxiv-2507-21449.title: From Global to Local: A Scalable Benchmark for Local Posterior Sampling
arxiv-2507-21449.creator: Rohan Hitchcock, Jesse Hoogland
arxiv-2507-21449.description: Abstract Degeneracy is an inherent feature of the loss landscape of neural networks, but it is not well understood how stochastic gradient MCMC (SGMCMC) algorithms interact with this degeneracy. In particular, current global convergence guarantees for common SGMCMC algorithms rely on assumptions which are likely incompatible with degenerate loss landscapes.

arxiv-2507-22141.title: Efficient handover based on Near-field and Far-field RIS for seamless connectivity
arxiv-2507-22141.creator: Atiquzzaman Mondal, Waheeb Tashan, Ayat Al-Olaimat, Hüseyin Arslan
arxiv-2507-22141.description: Abstract Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) is becoming a transformative technology for the upcoming 6G communication networks, providing a way for smartly maneuvering the electromagnetic waves to enhance coverage and connectivity. This paper presents an efficient handover (HO) management scheme leveraging RIS in the Fresnel region i.e.

arxiv-2509-06264.title: PLRV-O : Advancing Differentially Private Deep Learning via Privacy Loss Random Variable Optimization Conference: Proceedings of the 2025 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security; October 13–17, 2025; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of the 2025 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and C
arxiv-2509-06264.creator: Qin Yang, Nicholas Stout, Meisam Mohammady, Han Wang, Ayesha Samreen, Christopher J. Quinn, Yan Yan, Ashish Kundu, Yuan Hong
arxiv-2509-06264.description: Abstract . Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) is a standard method for enforcing privacy in deep learning, typically using the Gaussian mechanism to perturb gradient updates. However, conventional mechanisms such as Gaussian and Laplacian noise are parameterized only by variance or scale.

arxiv-2601-17764.title: Cross-Lingual Probing and Community-Grounded Analysis of Gender Bias in Low-Resource Bengali Thanks:
arxiv-2601-17764.creator: Md Asgor Hossain Reaj, Rajan Das Gupta, Jui Saha Pritha, Abdullah Al Noman, Abir Ahmed, Golam Md Mohiuddin, Tze Hui Liew
arxiv-2601-17764.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant success in recent years; yet, issues of intrinsic gender bias persist, especially in non-English languages. Although current research mostly emphasizes English, the linguistic and cultural biases inherent in Global South languages, like Bengali, are little examined.

britannica-1911-jordan-dorothea.title: Jordan, Dorothea (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-jordan-dorothea.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jordan-dorothea.description: Article 'Jordan, Dorothea' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. near Waterford, Ireland, in 1762. Her mother, Grace Phillips, at one time known as Mrs Frances, was a Dublin actress. Her father, whose name was Bland, was according to one account an army captain, but more probably a stage hand. Dorothy Jordan made her first appearance on the stage in 1777 in Dublin  as Phoebe in As You Like It.

europmc-pmc4229962.title: Prospect of stem cell conditioned medium in regenerative medicine.
europmc-pmc4229962.creator: Pawitan JA.
europmc-pmc4229962.description: Background Stem cell-derived conditioned medium has a promising prospect to be produced as pharmaceuticals for regenerative medicine. Objective To investigate various methods to obtain stem cell-derived conditioned medium (CM) to get an insight into their prospect of application

pmc-10731366.title: Relationships between body composition, anthropometrics, and standard lipid panels in a normative population
pmc-10731366.creator: Marcus Weeks, Andrew D. Delgado, Jamie Wood, Bodi Zhang, Sarah Pesce, Laura Kunces, Loukia Lili, David Putrino
pmc-10731366.description: IntroductionMore than one third of adults in the United States (US) meet the clinical criteria for a diagnosis of metabolic syndrome, but often diagnosis is challenging due to healthcare access, costs and discomfort with the process and invasiveness associated with a standard medical examination.

pmc-11451474.title: Oral Hydrogels that Balance Microbiome for Tumor Treatment
pmc-11451474.creator: Chu Jiang, Huajie Liu, Yinan Zhang
pmc-11451474.description: Intervening in the microbial environment holds promise for enhancing antitumor efficacy by reshaping the tumor microenvironment, yet few strategies have been reported. In a study led by Zou and coworkers, oral hydrogels are introduced to regulate the microbiota balance in the intestines and tumors, triggering an antitumor immune response.

pmc-11492699.title: Nomogram based on multimodal ultrasound features for evaluating breast nonmass lesions: a single center study
pmc-11492699.creator: Li-Fang Yu, Luo-Xi Zhu, Chao-Chao Dai, Xiao-Jing Xu, Yan-Juan Tan, Hong-Ju Yan, Ling-Yun Bao
pmc-11492699.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIt is challenging to correctly identify and diagnose breast nonmass lesions. This study aimed to explore the multimodal ultrasound features associated with malignant breast nonmass lesions (NMLs), and evaluate their combined diagnostic performance.MethodsThis retrospective analysis was conducted on 573 breast NMLs, including 309 were benign and 264 were malignant, their multimodal ultrasound features (B-mode, color Doppler and strain elastography) were assessed by two experienced radiologists.

pmc-11593408.title: The Chilean COVID-19 Genomics Network Biorepository: A Resource for Multi-Omics Studies of COVID-19 and Long COVID in a Latin American Population
pmc-11593408.creator: Iskra A Signore, Gerardo Donoso, Pamela Bocchieri, Eduardo A Tobar-Calfucoy, Cristian E Yáñez, Laura Carvajal-Silva, Andrea X Silva, Carola Otth, Claudio Cappelli, Héctor Valenzuela Jorquera, Daniela Zapata-Contreras, Yolanda Espinosa-Parrilla, Paula Zúñiga-Pacheco, Macarena Fuentes-Guajardo, Virgin
pmc-11593408.description: Although a lack of diversity in genetic studies is an acknowledged obstacle for personalized medicine and precision public health, Latin American populations remain particularly understudied despite their heterogeneity and mixed ancestry. This gap extends to COVID-19 despite its variability in susceptibility and clinical course, where ethnic background appears to influence disease severity, with non-Europeans facing higher hospitalization rates.

pmc-12467322.title: Introduced Western Honeybees Dramatically Reduce the Abundance of Wild Bees in Alpine Meadows, Eastern Tibet Plateau
pmc-12467322.creator: Ruimin An, Shucun Sun
pmc-12467322.description: Simple SummaryWestern honeybees have been introduced across China, yet their effects on native pollinators in alpine meadows remain unclear. We compared native bee abundance and diversity close to and far from apiaries on the eastern Tibetan Plateau, analyzing plant–bee networks and niche overlap (apparent competition) between honeybees and native species.

pmc-12526177.title: Physicochemical Properties and Quality of Bread Enriched with Haskap Berry (Lonicera caerulea L.) Pomace
pmc-12526177.creator: Grażyna Cacak-Pietrzak, Agata Marzec, Kacper Onisk, Stanisław Kalisz, Wioleta Dołomisiewicz, Renata Nowak, Anna Krajewska, Dariusz Dziki
pmc-12526177.description: Haskap berry (Lonicera caerulea L.) pomace, a by-product of juice processing, is a rich source of bioactive compounds. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of incorporating lyophilized and ground haskap berry pomace on the physicochemical properties of wheat bread. In addition, flour water absorption and dough rheological properties were assessed.

pmc-12657046.title: Induction of TFEB promotes Kupffer cell survival and reduces lipid accumulation in MASLD
pmc-12657046.creator: Mandy M. Chan, Sabine Daemen, Wandy Beatty, Kathleen Byrnes, Kevin Cho, Daniel Ferguson, Natalie Feldstein, Christopher Park, Zhen Guo, Arick C. Park, Christina F. Fu, Kira L. Florczak, Li He, Bin Q. Yang, Ali Javaheri, Gary J. Patti, Brian N. Finck, Babak Razani, Joel D. Schilling
pmc-12657046.description: Background:Kupffer cells (KCs) are the tissue-resident macrophages of the liver, where they serve a critical role in maintaining liver tissue homeostasis and act as a filter for circulation. The composition of hepatic macrophages changes during metabolic dysfunction–associated liver disease (MASLD), with the loss of resident KCs being a hallmark of disease progression.

pmc-12821614.title: Mechanisms, Economy, and Performance of Advanced Footwear Technology in Endurance Running—A Review
pmc-12821614.creator: Daido Dagne Bruvere, Edgars Bernans
pmc-12821614.description: Since the introduction of advanced footwear technology (AFT) in 2017, numerous world records from 5 km to the marathon have been broken. Among these innovations, carbon-plated shoes have received particular attention. Previous research indicates improvements of 2–4% in running economy (RE), which translates into an approximate 1–2% improvement in running performance when running in these shoes.

pmc-13332931.title: Exercise Training in the Fasted State During the Month of Ramadan: Acutely Ergolytic but Possibly Chronically Ergogenic? A Narrative Review with Systematic Search and Methodological Quality Assessment
pmc-13332931.creator: Jacky Hou An Ong, Khaled Trabelsi, Achraf Ammar, Jad Adrian Washif, Marcus J. C. Lee, Cheong Hwa Ooi, Karim Chamari, Ahmad Munir Che Muhamed, Mohammed Ihsan, Abdul Rashid Aziz
pmc-13332931.description: BackgroundDaytime acute exercise in the Ramadan-fasted state (without consuming food nor fluids before and during exercise) can lead to exacerbated physiological responses and poorer performance in fasting individuals. Consequently, chronic training adaptations under these conditions are often expected to be suboptimal compared with the same training sessions performed in the fed state.

pmc-13471575.title: Ionized hypocalcemia prior to continuous veno-venous hemodialysis initiation: prevalence and consequences
pmc-13471575.creator: Baptiste Thibault, Thomas Rimmelé, Matthieu Petit, Robert Pohlmeier, Marion Calmettes, Nicolas Chardon, Jean-François Carabalona, Florent Wallet, Frank Bidar
pmc-13471575.description: Regional citrate anticoagulation (RCA) is currently the first-line strategy during continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT). No international recommendation exists concerning the assessment of ionized calcium (iCa) prior to RCA-CRRT initiation and data on the consequences of pre-existing ionized hypocalcemia are lacking.

pmc-13520501.title: Isothermal miRNA Detection via Ligation-Dependent CRISPR/Cas13a Activation
pmc-13520501.creator: Jiyoon Lee, Jihyun Kim, Dong Yeon Jo, Suyeon Lee, Jung Kyoon Choi, Hyun Gyu Park
pmc-13520501.description: Here, we present a rapid isothermal strategy for miRNA detection based on ligation-dependent generation of Cas13a-activating RNA and CRISPR/Cas13a-mediated signal amplification. The system employs two DNA probes: a hairpin-structured probe containing a double-stranded T7 promoter within its stem and a second probe encoding a template for Cas13a activator RNA.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7216.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7216 — Leader of Army Band: appointment
uslaw-usc-t10-s7216.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7216.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 723 (Special Appointments, Assignments, Details, And Duties). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary of the Army may appoint the leader of the Army band from the warrant officers of the Regular Army. The leader serves during the pleasure of the Secretary and may be returned to his former status.
